fullText.simplified:
大天和李二

    包大人让他的卫士大天去陈家村。这个大天跟着包大人已经很多年了，他的功夫很厉害。
    大天只用了十天时间就来到了陈家村。他先找到了村长，一个五十多岁的老头。村长说，香儿的话是真的。
    大天又找到了香儿的邻居，一个六十多岁的张奶奶。张奶奶说的也跟香儿说的一样。村里别的人也都这么说。大天把他们的话全都写了下来。
    接着，大天带上村长和张奶奶两个证人一起回京城。就在回去的路上，陈世美的卫士来了。
    陈世美的卫士名叫李二，他以前见过大天。不过大天不认识他，所以不知道他是陈世美的人。
    李二一直跟在大天后面。他知道大天的功夫很厉害，他打不过。所以他要等，他要找机会。等大天不在的时候，才能杀村长和张奶奶。
    李二一直跟着大天他们。快到京城了，李二有点着急，再不能杀掉证人，等他们进了京城，想杀人就没那么容易了。正想着，机会来了。
    那一天晚上，大天他们三个人找了一个客店住下以后，村长不知道为什么，一个人走出了客店。
    李二跟在村长后面，在一个没有人的小路上，把村长杀了。之后，他又想杀张奶奶。可是客店里面人太多，他一时间找不到机会，只好等着。
    大天一路上十分小心，不敢离开这两个证人。这一天村长突然不见了，他觉得很奇怪，就出门去找村长，可是一直找到天黑，也没有找着。大天心想：村长一定是被人杀了。
    但是，怎么才能查出是谁杀了村长呢？
fullText.traditional:
大天和李二

    包大人讓他的衛士大天去陳家村。這個大天跟著包大人已經很多年了，他的功夫很厲害。
    大天只用了十天時間就來到了陳家村。他先找到了村長，一個五十多歲的老頭。村長說，香兒的話是真的。
    大天又找到了香兒的鄰居，一個六十多歲的張奶奶。張奶奶說的也跟香兒說的一樣。村裡別的人也都這麼說。大天把他們的話全都寫了下來。
    接著，大天帶上村長和張奶奶兩個證人一起回京城。就在回去的路上，陳世美的衛士來了。
    陳世美的衛士名叫李二，他以前見過大天。不過大天不認識他，所以不知道他是陳世美的人。
    李二一直跟在大天後面。他知道大天的功夫很厲害，他打不過。所以他要等，他要找機會。等大天不在的時候，才能殺村長和張奶奶。
    李二一直跟著大天他們。快到京城了，李二有點著急，再不能殺掉證人，等他們進了京城，想殺人就沒那麼容易了。正想著，機會來了。
    那一天晚上，大天他們三個人找了一個客店住下以後，村長不知道為什麼，一個人走出了客店。
    李二跟在村長後面，在一個沒有人的小路上，把村長殺了。之後，他又想殺張奶奶。可是客店裡面人太多，他一時間找不到機會，只好等著。
    大天一路上十分小心，不敢離開這兩個證人。這一天村長突然不見了，他覺得很奇怪，就出門去找村長，可是一直找到天黑，也沒有找著。大天心想：村長一定是被人殺了。
    但是，怎麼才能查出是誰殺了村長呢？

sentences.simplified: 包大人让他的卫士大天去陈家村。
sentences.traditional: 包大人讓他的衛士大天去陳家村。
sentences.pinyin: bāo dà rén ràng tā de wèi shì dà tiān qù chén jiā cūn
sentences.english: Lord Bao had his guard Datian go to the Chen family village.

sentences.simplified: 这个大天跟着包大人已经很多年了，他的功夫很厉害。
sentences.traditional: 這個大天跟著包大人已經很多年了，他的功夫很厲害。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dà tiān gēn zhe bāo dà rén yǐ jīng hěn duō nián le tā de gōng fu hěn lì hai
sentences.english: Datian had been with Lord Bao for many years, and he was very formidable.

sentences.simplified: 大天只用了十天时间就来到了陈家村。
sentences.traditional: 大天只用了十天時間就來到了陳家村。
sentences.pinyin: dà tiān zhǐ yòng le shí tiān shí jiān jiù lái dào le chén jiā cūn
sentences.english: It only took Datian ten days to arrive at the Chen family village.

sentences.simplified: 他先找到了村长，一个五十多岁的老头。
sentences.traditional: 他先找到了村長，一個五十多歲的老頭。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān zhǎo dào le cūn zhǎng yí ge wǔ shí duō suì de lǎo tóu
sentences.english: He first found the village chief, an old man in his fifties.

sentences.simplified: 村长说，香儿的话是真的。
sentences.traditional: 村長說，香兒的話是真的。
sentences.pinyin: cūn zhǎng shuō xiāng er de huà shì zhēn de
sentences.english: The village chief said that what Xiang’er had said was true.

sentences.simplified: 大天又找到了香儿的邻居，一个六十多岁的张奶奶。
sentences.traditional: 大天又找到了香兒的鄰居，一個六十多歲的張奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: dà tiān yòu zhǎo dào le xiāng er de lín jū yí ge liù shí duō suì de zhāng nǎi nai
sentences.english: Datian then found Xiang’er’s neighbor, Grandma Zhang, who was in her sixties.

sentences.simplified: 张奶奶说的也跟香儿说的一样。
sentences.traditional: 張奶奶說的也跟香兒說的一樣。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng nǎi nai shuō de yě gēn xiāng er shuō de yí yàng
sentences.english: What Grandma Zhang said was also the same as what Xiang’er had said.

sentences.simplified: 村里别的人也都这么说。大天把他们的话全都写了下来。
sentences.traditional: 村裡別的人也都這麼說。大天把他們的話全都寫了下來。
sentences.pinyin: cūn lǐ bié de rén yě dōu zhè me shuō dà tiān bǎ tā men de huà quán dōu xiě le xia lai
sentences.english: The other people in the village also said the same thing. Datian wrote down everything they said.

sentences.simplified: 接着，大天带上村长和张奶奶两个证人一起回京城。
sentences.traditional: 接著，大天帶上村長和張奶奶兩個證人一起回京城。
sentences.pinyin: jiē zhe dà tiān dài shàng cūn zhǎng hé zhāng nǎi nai liǎng ge zhèng rén yì qǐ huí jīng chéng
sentences.english: After that, Datian brought the two witnesses, the village chief and Grandma Zhang, back to the capital city with him.

sentences.simplified: 就在回去的路上，陈世美的卫士来了。
sentences.traditional: 就在回去的路上，陳世美的衛士來了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài huí qù de lù shang chén shì měi de wèi shì lái le
sentences.english: On their journey back, Chen Shimei’s guard appeared.

sentences.simplified: 陈世美的卫士名叫李二，他以前见过大天。
sentences.traditional: 陳世美的衛士名叫李二，他以前見過大天。
sentences.pinyin: chén shì měi de wèi shì míng jiào lǐ èr tā yǐ qián jiàn guò dà tiān
sentences.english: Chen Shimei’s guard was named Li’er, and he had seen Datian before.

sentences.simplified: 不过大天不认识他，所以不知道他是陈世美的人。
sentences.traditional: 不過大天不認識他，所以不知道他是陳世美的人。
sentences.pinyin: bú guò dà tiān bú rèn shi tā suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào tā shì chén shì měi de rén
sentences.english: However, Datian did not know him, so he was not aware that he worked for Chen Shimei.

sentences.simplified: 李二一直跟在大天后面。
sentences.traditional: 李二一直跟在大天後面。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ èr yì zhí gēn zài dà tiān hòu miàn
sentences.english: Li’er kept following behind Datian.

sentences.simplified: 他知道大天的功夫很厉害，他打不过。
sentences.traditional: 他知道大天的功夫很厲害，他打不過。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào dà tiān de gōng fu hěn lì hai tā dǎ bú guò
sentences.english: He knew that Datian was very formidable, and that he could not beat Datian in a fight.

sentences.simplified: 所以他要等，他要找机会。
sentences.traditional: 所以他要等，他要找機會。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā yào děng tā yào zhǎo jī huì
sentences.english: So he needed to wait; he needed to find an opportunity.

sentences.simplified: 等大天不在的时候，才能杀村长和张奶奶。
sentences.traditional: 等大天不在的時候，才能殺村長和張奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: děng dà tiān bú zài de shí hou cái néng shā cūn zhǎng hé zhāng nǎi nai
sentences.english: He had to wait for a moment when Datian was gone, and only then could he kill the village chief and Grandma Zhang.

sentences.simplified: 李二一直跟着大天他们。
sentences.traditional: 李二一直跟著大天他們。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ èr yì zhí gēn zhe dà tiān tā men
sentences.english: Li’er continued following them and Datian.

sentences.simplified: 快到京城了，李二有点着急，
sentences.traditional: 快到京城了，李二有點著急，
sentences.pinyin: kuài dào jīng chéng le lǐ èr yǒu diǎn zháo jí
sentences.english: When they were almost at the capital city, Li’er started to worry.

sentences.simplified: 再不能杀掉证人，
sentences.traditional: 再不能殺掉證人，
sentences.pinyin: zài bù néng shā diào zhèng rén
sentences.english: If he still couldn’t kill the witnesses, ..

sentences.simplified: 等他们进了京城，想杀人就没那么容易了。
sentences.traditional: 等他們進了京城，想殺人就沒那麼容易了。
sentences.pinyin: děng tā men jìn le jīng chéng xiǎng shā rén jiù méi nà me róng yì le
sentences.english: .. waiting until they arrived in the capital city would make it harder to kill them.

sentences.simplified: 正想着，机会来了。
sentences.traditional: 正想著，機會來了。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng xiǎng zhe jī huì lái le
sentences.english: Just as he was thinking, the opportunity came.

sentences.simplified: 那一天晚上，大天他们三个人找了一个客店住下以后，
sentences.traditional: 那一天晚上，大天他們三個人找了一個客店住下以後，
sentences.pinyin: nà yì tiān wǎn shang dà tiān tā men sān ge rén zhǎo le yí ge kè diàn zhù xià yǐ hòu
sentences.english: That night, after Datian and the others had found an inn to stay in, ..

sentences.simplified: 村长不知道为什么，一个人走出了客店。
sentences.traditional: 村長不知道為什麼，一個人走出了客店。
sentences.pinyin: cūn zhǎng bù zhī dào wèi shén me yí ge rén zǒu chū le kè diàn
sentences.english: .. the village chief walked out of the inn by himself for some reason.

sentences.simplified: 李二跟在村长后面，在一个没有人的小路上，把村长杀了。
sentences.traditional: 李二跟在村長後面，在一個沒有人的小路上，把村長殺了。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ èr gēn zài cūn zhǎng hòu miàn zài yí ge méi yǒu rén de xiǎo lù shang bǎ cūn zhǎng shā le
sentences.english: Li’er followed behind the village chief, and on a small and empty road, killed the village chief.

sentences.simplified: 之后，他又想杀张奶奶。
sentences.traditional: 之後，他又想殺張奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu tā yòu xiǎng shā zhāng nǎi nai
sentences.english: Afterwards, he also wanted to kill Grandma Zhang.

sentences.simplified: 可是客店里面人太多，他一时间找不到机会，只好等着。
sentences.traditional: 可是客店裡面人太多，他一時間找不到機會，只好等著。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì kè diàn lǐ miàn rén tài duō tā yì shí jiān zhǎo bú dào jī huì zhǐ hǎo děng zhe
sentences.english: But there were too many people in the inn, and he couldn’t find an opportunity at that moment, so he could only wait.

sentences.simplified: 大天一路上十分小心，不敢离开这两个证人。
sentences.traditional: 大天一路上十分小心，不敢離開這兩個證人。
sentences.pinyin: dà tiān yí lù shang shí fēn xiǎo xīn bù gǎn lí kāi zhè liǎng ge zhèng rén
sentences.english: Datian was very careful the whole way, not daring to leave these two witnesses.

sentences.simplified: 这一天村长突然不见了，他觉得很奇怪，
sentences.traditional: 這一天村長突然不見了，他覺得很奇怪，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān cūn zhǎng tū rán bú jiàn le tā jué de hěn qí guài
sentences.english: On the day the village chief suddenly disappeared, he thought it was very strange, ..

sentences.simplified: 就出门去找村长，
sentences.traditional: 就出門去找村長，
sentences.pinyin: jiù chū mén qù zhǎo cūn zhǎng
sentences.english: .. so he left to go find the village chief.

sentences.simplified: 可是一直找到天黑，也没有找着。
sentences.traditional: 可是一直找到天黑，也沒有找著。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yì zhí zhǎo dào tiān hēi yě méi yǒu zhǎo zháo
sentences.english: However, he looked until it went dark and still did not find him.

sentences.simplified: 大天心想：村长一定是被人杀了。
sentences.traditional: 大天心想：村長一定是被人殺了。
sentences.pinyin: dà tiān xīn xiǎng cūn zhǎng yí dìng shì bèi rén shā le
sentences.english: Datian thought to himself: the village chief must have been killed by someone.

sentences.simplified: 但是，怎么才能查出是谁杀了村长呢？
sentences.traditional: 但是，怎麼才能查出是誰殺了村長呢？
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zěn me cái néng chá chū shì shéi shā le cūn zhǎng ne
sentences.english: But, how could he find out who killed the village chief?

sentence_translations: Datian and Li’er
Lord Bao had his guard Datian go to the Chen family village.
Datian had been with Lord Bao for many years, and he was very formidable.
It only took Datian ten days to arrive at the Chen family village.
He first found the village chief, an old man in his fifties.
The village chief said that what Xiang’er had said was true.
Datian then found Xiang’er’s neighbor, Grandma Zhang, who was in her sixties.
What Grandma Zhang said was also the same as what Xiang’er had said.
The other people in the village also said the same thing. Datian wrote down everything they said.
After that, Datian brought the two witnesses, the village chief and Grandma Zhang, back to the capital city with him.
On their journey back, Chen Shimei’s guard appeared.
Chen Shimei’s guard was named Li’er, and he had seen Datian before.
However, Datian did not know him, so he was not aware that he worked for Chen Shimei.
Li’er kept following behind Datian.
He knew that Datian was very formidable, and that he could not beat Datian in a fight.
So he needed to wait; he needed to find an opportunity.
He had to wait for a moment when Datian was gone, and only then could he kill the village chief and Grandma Zhang.
Li’er continued following them and Datian.
When they were almost at the capital city, Li’er started to worry.
If he still couldn’t kill the witnesses, ..
.. waiting until they arrived in the capital city would make it harder to kill them.
Just as he was thinking, the opportunity came.
That night, after Datian and the others had found an inn to stay in, ..
.. the village chief walked out of the inn by himself for some reason.
Li’er followed behind the village chief, and on a small and empty road, killed the village chief.
Afterwards, he also wanted to kill Grandma Zhang.
But there were too many people in the inn, and he couldn’t find an opportunity at that moment, so he could only wait.
Datian was very careful the whole way, not daring to leave these two witnesses.
On the day the village chief suddenly disappeared, he thought it was very strange, ..
.. so he left to go find the village chief.
However, he looked until it went dark and still did not find him.
Datian thought to himself: the village chief must have been killed by someone.
But, how could he find out who killed the village chief?
